sources.snippet: Fixed jinja chat templates for Qwen 3.5 & 3.6 (v21) This is a drop-in Jinja template that fixes rendering errors, KV cache invalidation, token waste, and fatal agentic stalling in the official Qwen chat templates. sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Fixed-Chat-Templates is a drop-in replacement for the Jinja chat templates used by Qwen 3.5 and Qwen 3.6 language models. Created by froggeric, these templates fix six critical bugs in the official Qwen implementations that break tool calling, cause token waste, and crash in common runtime scenarios. The templates work across all major inference engines—LM Studio, llama.cpp ...
